title: Mine

errors.user-rejected: Wallet request cancelled. You can try again.
errors.wrong-chain: Switch to BNB Smart Chain Testnet (97).
errors.account-changed: Wallet account changed. Review your selection and try again.
errors.invalid-amount: Enter a positive per-cell BNB amount with up to 6 decimals
errors.insufficient-native: Insufficient BNB for deployment and Gas
errors.duplicate-cell: This round already contains your deployment. Refresh before continuing.
errors.already-deployed-round: Already deployed this round. A second Manual deploy is not allowed.
errors.different-amount: The contract rejected this per-cell amount. Refresh before continuing.
errors.round-unavailable: Round unavailable or changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.checkpoint-required: Previous round needs settlement. Refresh; no settlement transaction was sent.
errors.simulation-reverted: Deployment check failed. No wallet transaction was requested.
errors.rpc-error: Could not complete the request. Check your network and try again.
errors.confirmation-unknown: Confirmation is unknown. Check this transaction before doing anything else.
errors.verification-failed: Chain confirmed, but the deployment event could not be verified. Do not resend.
errors.refresh-failed: Chain confirmed, but data refresh failed. Retry refresh only.
errors.replaced: The transaction was replaced or cancelled. Refresh to check deployment state.

transaction.accountUnavailable: Account deployment state unavailable; submission disabled.
transaction.perCell: Input is BNB per cell; total principal = amount per cell × cell count.
transaction.otherPending: A previous operation is still pending. Wait for confirmation.

autoFlow.funding: Per-cell BNB. Totals show principal; wallet funding also includes executor fees and Gas

errors.already-active: Automation is already active. Refresh its state.
errors.not-active: No active automation to stop. Refresh its state.
errors.fee-changed: Executor fee changed or is unavailable. Refresh and review.

rewardsReadOnly: Read-only rewards. Claim transactions are not enabled.

phases.refresh-failed: Chain confirmed · refresh failed. Retry refresh only.
phases.verification-failed: Chain confirmed · verification failed. Do not resend.
